purpose: Teach: 年長/憤り/カンタン/逝っ/ねらっ/まっか/他界/対極

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが年長の親戚にご挨拶されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father went over to greet the older relatives.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight lift on 'Sho' at the start — getting his attention. Casual pace, as if sharing a simple observation from the day. No strain.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが不正に憤りを感じてらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I noticed Dad seemed upset about something unfair.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Not accusatory — just observing. Small pause before 'unfair' like he's searching for the right word. Genuine concern underneath, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「カンタンには諦めない」って仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he won't give up that easily.
lines.style: Warm pride in her voice. Slight emphasis on 'won't give up' — defending her husband gently. Slow, deliberate pace. The comfort of reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが逝ってしまわれて寂しいよ
lines.en: Mom, I feel sad that Grandpa passed away.
lines.style: Very quiet. Small, vulnerable voice. No rushing — he's letting the sadness sit. Trailing off slightly at the end, like he's checking if it's okay to say it out loud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが流れ星をねらって写真を撮ろうとされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father tried to photograph a shooting star.
lines.style: Light, almost amused tone. Warm nostalgia in the voice. Slight breathy quality — remembering something tender he witnessed. Soft delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、走ったら顔がまっかになっちゃったよ
lines.en: Mom, I ran so hard my face turned bright red.
lines.style: Small, self-aware laugh underneath. Slight embarrassment but not serious about it. Light, quick pace. The vulnerability of admitting something silly, softened by his own humor.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが他界された日を毎年偲ぶわね
lines.en: Sho, we remember your grandfather every year on that day.
lines.style: Gentle, almost meditative tone. The weight of ritual and love, but not heavy. Slow pace. A quiet acknowledgment of loss that's become part of their family rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとは対極の性格だってよく言われるよ
lines.en: Mom, people always say I'm nothing like Dad.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware. Slight smile in the voice — not bitter, just noticing the irony. Conversational pace. The comfort of acceptance mixed with a touch of dry humor.
